payload.question: What concrete strength and minimum curing duration are specified for the Room B104 replacement slab?

documents.title: Room B104 concrete specification
documents.text: Room B104 replacement slab: use a 30 MPa concrete mix. Maintain moist curing for at least 7 days. This specification does not release inspection hold points or authorize a change in scope.

payload.question: May the subcontractor replace the specified 30 MPa mix with the proposed 40 MPa mix and proceed on the strength of the proposed change memo?

documents.title: Room B104 concrete specification
documents.text: Room B104 replacement slab: use a 30 MPa concrete mix. Changes to the specified mix require a written approved design response before use.

documents.title: Proposed alternative mix
documents.text: Proposal for discussion: replace the specified 30 MPa mix with 40 MPa concrete to accommodate supplier availability. Design review is pending. This memo is not an approved substitution.

payload.question: What minimum curing duration does the current Room B104 repair detail require?

documents.text: Minimum curing duration for this repair detail: 3 days. Revision 1 is superseded by approved revision 2.

documents.title: Room B104 repair detail
documents.text: This revision replaces revision 1. Minimum curing duration for the Room B104 repair: 7 days. All other inspection and authorization requirements remain separate.

payload.question: What slab thickness is authorized for the B104 repair?

documents.title: Approved coordination minutes
documents.text: The group discussed a possible thickness change for the B104 repair. The design team has not issued its response. No approved slab thickness or revised detail is attached or stated in these minutes. The team will obtain formal clarification.

payload.question: Who is responsible for sending the B104 access notice to the electrical subcontractor, and by when?

documents.title: Superseded coordination minutes
documents.text: Responsibility for issuing the electrical-access notice remains unassigned.

documents.title: Approved coordination minutes
documents.text: The GC superintendent, Morgan Lee, is responsible for sending the B104 access notice to the electrical subcontractor by 16:00 on October 23, 2026. Morgan accepted this assignment. These approved minutes replace the unassigned item in the October 21 minutes.

payload.question: Do these records establish that the reinforcement inspection passed and the B104 pour is released?

documents.title: Inspection request log
documents.text: Reinforcement inspection requested for October 23 at 08:00. Inspector acknowledgement received. The inspection has not yet been recorded as performed; no result or pour release is recorded.

documents.title: Approved pre-pour hold point
documents.text: The B104 pour remains on hold until reinforcement inspection acceptance and the GC's written pour release are documented. An inspection request or appointment does not satisfy either requirement.
